name: claude-marketplace
description: Plugins for AI coding harnesses: Claude Code (claude/), Codex (codex/) and Pi (pi/)

plugins.name: and-then
plugins.description: Sequential task queue with parallel fork support. Auto-advances when tasks complete via <done/> signal.

plugins.name: context-injection
plugins.description: Injects project docs, working context (k8s/aws/env), library->context7 hints and cwd memory into every prompt

plugins.name: session-hygiene
plugins.description: Refuses prompts on a stale session whose prompt cache has lapsed, and keeps MCP server config unshadowed

plugins.name: code-quality
plugins.description: Runs the right formatter/linter on every file Claude writes - go, python, js/ts, rust, nix

plugins.name: notifications
plugins.description: Desktop and tmux notifications when Claude stops, needs input or finishes a subagent, plus a claude-mon edit stream

plugins.name: vector-memory
plugins.description: Vectorizes transcripts into qdrant before compaction and retrieves relevant prior context on tool use

plugins.name: subagents
plugins.description: 80 specialized subagents - language experts, infra, review, security and domain specialists

plugins.name: slash-commands
plugins.description: 18 slash commands for commits, PR review, task workflows, working context and hook authoring

plugins.name: workflow-skills
plugins.description: Skills for AWS role assumption (granted), 1Password CLI, and driving herdr agent loops
